question: Should the 741/742/745 feeder be treated as one graphic allograph family or as a syntactic alloseries of distinct catalog signs?
visual_decision: Do not merge 741/742/745 as one proven graphic allograph family. The local images support the terminal environment and the source reality of the cluster, but they do not force a single-shape reading across 741, 742, and 745.
model_update: Keep 741/742/745 as a syntactic alloseries: three catalog signs that share a distributional feeder role selecting 060-920. The distributional claim is promoted; the graphic-allograph claim is not.
effect_on_selector_claim: Strengthens the conservative formulation. The selector result no longer depends on visual identity among 741/742/745; it only requires that clean catalog signs in the immediately-left slot overwhelmingly choose 060-920 and never sibling caps in the tested universe.
next_destructive_test: If a future source-normalized shape classifier can cluster 741/742/745 above matched sign-neighborhood controls, reopen the allograph-family hypothesis. Until then, call it alloseries, not allograph.
